merge_shadow.lede: Manshoji Temple will hold its annual special cultural-property viewing and flea market on 3 November (Tue, public holiday) in Oyabe, Yokosuka.
merge_shadow.summary: Manshoji Temple, which enshrines Miura Daisuke Yoshiaki, who laid the foundations for the Miura clan's rise, will hold its annual special cultural-property viewing on Culture Day. Visitors can see the temple's Important Cultural Property, a seated statue of Miura Yoshiaki, as well as the Dragon painting and Horai Garden, which are normally not open to the public. The viewing will run from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. in the temple's main hall and treasure hall, and costs 700 yen; admission is free for elementary school students and younger. A monk band and flea market are also planned, with free admission to the flea market's kitchen-car area; inquiries can be made at 046 (836) 2317.
merge_shadow.title: Manshoji Temple to Open Cultural Properties to Public; Flea Market Also Planned

merge_shadow.lede: The Miura Rockabilly Festival will take place on 3 November (Tue, holiday) at the second-floor observation deck of the Urari farm-direct sales facility in Misaki.
merge_shadow.summary: The festival will run from 11:00 to 17:00, with live performances by seven groups, merchandise sales, dance lessons and a free hair and makeup experience; admission is free. The event will celebrate rockabilly, music that originated in the American South in the 1950s and is represented by artists such as Elvis Presley; the new item describes rockabilly as music originating in America. For inquiries, contact the organizing committee at 046 (888) 2157.
merge_shadow.title: Miura Rockabilly Festival to Feature Live Music, Merchandise and Dance Lessons
